D: A cool-headed advisor plays rival gang bosses against each other in a Prohibition-era town.
P: Plate up when Tom goes back into the woods looking for his hat.
S: Hard-boil eggs 9 minutes, peel, pack into a jar with hot brine of vinegar, sugar, salt, beetroot juice and peppercorns. Pickle 3 days in the fridge.
Leo's greeting when Tom walks in

Sear chicken livers pink, deglaze with brandy, blitz with butter, thyme and shallot until silky, set under clarified butter. Trim 400g chicken livers and sear in butter for 2 minutes a side until still pink. Add 2 chopped shallots and thyme, then 40ml brandy and let it bubble off. Blitz with 150g soft butter until silky, season and press into a dish. Pour over 50g melted clarified butter and chill 4 hours. Serve with 8 slices toasted rye.
it's a question of ethics, Johnny says

Puff pastry with egg, aged cheddar, parmesan and cayenne, folded, cut, twisted, baked at 220C for 12 minutes. Brush 2 sheets puff pastry with 1 beaten egg. Scatter one sheet with 80g grated aged cheddar, 30g grated parmesan and a pinch of cayenne, lay the other on top and press. Cut into 1.5cm strips, twist each and bake at 220C for 12 minutes until puffed and golden.
M: put the record on and let it simmer low

Brown lamb neck chops, layer with onion, carrot and potato, add stock and a bottle of stout, cover and braise at 160C for 2 hours. Brown 1.2kg lamb neck chops in batches. Layer in a heavy pot with 2 sliced brown onions, 3 carrots in chunks and 800g potatoes in thick slices. Pour over 375ml stout and 300ml beef stock, cover and braise at 160C for 2 hours until tender. Finish with chopped parsley.
talk about ethics while you eat it
Crumble Italian sausage into olive oil and brown, add garlic, chilli and a splash of cream and tomato, toss with penne and parmesan.
W: Layer buttered stale brioche with raisins soaked in Irish whiskey, pour over custard of 4 eggs, milk, cream and sugar, rest 30 minutes, bake at 170C for 40 minutes.
K: Tom Reagan's hot Irish whiskey toddy
Tom never puts his glass down, whatever the weather

Irish whiskey with honey, lemon and hot water, a clove-studded lemon wheel and a cinnamon stick to stir. Boil 600ml water. Stud 4 lemon wheels with 3 cloves each. In each of 4 heatproof glasses, put 45ml Irish whiskey, 1 tbsp honey and 15ml lemon juice. Top each with 150ml just-boiled water and stir until the honey dissolves. Float a studded lemon wheel on top, add a cinnamon stick and serve hot.
